name: Vetro
_about: An Italian GT style cluster, generated by tools/gen_vetro.py (edit that and regenerate): one rdash layer draws a perforated floor, the rev counter under glass (its face black, red or yellow: "vetroDial"), a blue panel with four bars and the fuel on the left and a glass tyre panel on the right; the numbers, speed, gear and readings are text over it. Nothing in the strip.
